lines.t: I tried to hide the things that I had done
Buried them deep where no one else could see
But every day the silence grew so loud
Your spirit kept on whispering to me
The weight inside my chest began to grow
Until at last I could not hold it in
With trembling heart and tears I finally spoke
And laid before you everything within
I let my tears flow, I let myself weep, I let myself be cleansed
I ask for forgiveness and mercy, you said
For only the Spirit of truth will bring forth conviction unto righteousness
Bearing much fruit in the beloved
So I will no longer resist the cleansing of the Lord
My heart breaks open as I speak the truth
Ashamed of all the wrong that I did
I taste the soul within my tears
The pain of hiding is finally gone
Yet in your love you gently lead me
And even in my sorrow you hold me near
The truth may sting but still it sets me free
Your grace is always waiting there for me
I let my tears flow, I let myself weep
I let myself be cleansed, I ask for forgiveness and mercy
You said, for only the spirit of truth will bring forth conviction unto righteousness
Bearing much fruit in the beloved
So I will no longer resist the cleansing of the Lord
Break the pride that blinds my wandering heart
Wash away the things that keep us apart
Let your truth grow deep inside of me
Until your fruit is all the world can see
So I let my tears flow
I let myself weep
I let myself be cleansed
I ask for forgiveness and mercy
For the spirit of truth is leading me
Into the life you meant for me
And I will no longer resist
The cleansing of the Lord
Thanks for watching!
